# Dependencies for the project site only — deliberately NOT in backend/pyproject.toml.
#
# The docs site is repo-root tooling and has nothing to do with the application's runtime or test
# dependencies. Putting it in the backend's dev group would install a web theme into the venv that runs
# the test suite, and would make `uv sync` slower for everyone who never builds the site.
#
# Pinned exactly, for the same reason ruff and mypy are: a theme that changes its rendering between
# builds turns "the docs look different" into a question nobody can answer from the diff.
mkdocs==1.6.1
mkdocs-material==9.7.7
